The plate is a round white disc about 350 px across. If it is a ~26 cm dinner plate, that gives roughly 0.074 cm per px.

The food is about 135 px wide and 115 px tall, so roughly 10 cm by 8.5 cm. It looks like a bread roll or a slice of bread, or possibly a meatloaf-like piece. It appears to be a roll half with a crust, with a cut face visible.

A piece of that size is probably about 10×8×3 cm. At about 0.5 g/cm³ for bread, that is around 60–80 g. At about 270 kcal per 100 g for bread, that is roughly 200 kcal.

If it were meatloaf, the same dimensions would give about 200 g and 350 kcal. The surface looks like bread with a crust, so I'll go with bread at about 75 g and 200 kcal.
